description: Everything FoodSight says to users. Write like a friendly local guide: plain words, short sentences, and a next step when something can't be done. Never mention data, databases, records, filters or queries. Values in braces are filled in by the code. Restart the backend after edits.

maps.missing_coordinates: I found some places, but I don’t know exactly where they are, so I can’t show them on the map.
maps.partial_coordinates: A few places don’t have an exact location, so they aren’t shown on the map.

errors.out_of_scope: Sorry, I can only help with food and drink, like finding restaurants, comparing places, checking prices or menus, or F&B business questions.
errors.unsupported_capability: Sorry, I can’t help with {capabilities} yet.
errors.outside: Sorry, that’s outside what I can help with. I’m best at food, drinks and restaurants.
errors.clarify: Could you say that in another way?
errors.unknown: Sorry, I didn’t quite get that. Could you try rephrasing it?
errors.answer: Sorry, something went wrong while I was putting your answer together. Please try again.
errors.no_results: Sorry, I couldn’t find anything that matches.
errors.unavailable: Sorry, I can’t look up restaurants right now. Please try again in a moment.
errors.retrieval: Sorry, I couldn’t get that information just now. Please try again.
errors.validation: Sorry, I couldn’t run that search. Could you try asking in a different way?
errors.unexpected: Sorry, something went wrong on my side. Please try again.

interface.message_limit: That message is a bit long. Please keep it under {maximum} words.
interface.chat_not_found: Sorry, I couldn’t find that chat.

location.permission: I can find {venue} near you if you share your location. Is that okay?
